function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/aflplusplus && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/afl-fuzz-mutators.c')
text=p.read_text()
old='''  mutator->name = fn;
  if (memchr(fn, \'/\', strlen(fn)))
    mutator->name_short = strrchr(fn, \'/\') + 1;
  else
    mutator->name_short = strdup(fn);
'''
new='''  mutator->name = fn;
  if (memchr(fn, \'/\', strlen(fn)))
    mutator->name_short = strrchr(fn, \'/\') + 1;
  else
    mutator->name_short = ck_strdup((u8 *)fn);
'''
p.write_text(text.replace(old,new))
PY
